$comment: The landing page and the audit screen share one palette: ../tokens.json. The visual pass added its new values THERE, not here, and styles.css mirrors each one - a second palette in this file would mean two products. This file records only what is specific to the landing page. See README.md for what was reconciled and why.

layout.$why: A landing page has one thing to press; --control-height (42px) is sized for a form with a dozen controls.

leading.$why: tokens.json has carried leading.tight/normal/loose from the start, but styles.css never defined the matching CSS variables, so any use of var(--leading-tight) fell back to a hardcoded guess. They are now in styles.css and the landing page uses them.

usesUnchanged.colour: every value from ../tokens.json - accent #0E7C7B for the action and the zero-fabricated column, deduct #8C2F2F for a reduced amount, flag #9A6410 for a flagged line
usesUnchanged.radius: sm and md for panels, pill for the step markers
usesUnchanged.font: sans for prose, mono for the bill and every clause id

addedToTheSharedFile.$why: Introduced by the landing page, defined in ../tokens.json and styles.css, and now used by the audit screen too.
